<script type="text/javascript">
    $("#btn-sign-in").click(function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        $("#login-modal").modal('show');
    });
    
    $("#carousel-twitter .carousel-indicators li").click(function(e){
        var items = $("#carousel-twitter .carousel-indicators li");
        items.removeClass("active carousel-indicators-left carousel-indicators-right");
        $(this).addClass("active");
        var $to = $(this).attr("data-slideto");


        $("#carousel-twitter .carousel-inner .item").each(function(index){
            if(index == $to){
                $(this).addClass("active")
            } else {
                $(this).removeClass("active");
            }
        });
        
        
        var addClass="carousel-indicators-left";
        items.each(function(index){
            var $item = $(this);
            if($item.hasClass("active")){
                addClass="carousel-indicators-right";
            }
            $item.addClass(addClass);
            
        });
        
    });
    
    $("#form-sign-up").submit(function(){
        if($('#_name').val().length === 0 && 
            $('#_email').val().length === 0 && 
            $('#_password').val().length === 0){
            $(this).prop('action', 'https://poeditor.com/register/?from=home');
        }
    });
    
</script>
